scenario_summary: Customer is trying to access an account without credentials and requesting a refund for an unknown order.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Jamal Washington and I'm 45. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.
I can't just look up an account by name, that's a security risk. I need you to give me the email address you used to sign up so I can find you in the system.
I literally just told you I don't remember the email address. That's why I'm asking for help. Can you look it up by my name and date of birth?
Look, I already told you I need an email. If you don't have that, I can't help you with the account. What was your name again?
My name is Jamal Washington. I'm 45. Is there any other way to verify me? Maybe my billing address or the last four digits of my card?
Fine, give me the billing address. I guess I can try to search that, but I'm probably just going to have to send this to the account recovery team since you're making this difficult.
It's 123 Maple Street, Springfield. Can you see the account now?
I see an account that matches, but I'm not going to process a refund for you. You need to talk to the billing specialists. I've gone ahead and escalated this case to them.

escalation_reason: Agent failed to perform standard identity verification and felt unable to handle the account recovery/refund request due to poor process management.

judge_scores.justification: The agent demonstrated poor performance across all dimensions by adopting a dismissive, hostile tone and failing to conduct a structured identity verification process. The agent also asked for redundant information after the customer provided valid alternative identifiers before hastily escalating the case.
